title: The resolved-conflict check misses a dropped method or a dropped top-level assignment
goal: The resolved-conflict command in /kb-git-sync and /kb-item (ST-ikxgirce) compares every definition both sides added, a class's methods and top-level assignments included, not only top-level def and class names, so a resolution that drops one side's method added to a shared class prints it as lost and exits 1. Found by the SP-wmukiu3s review.

run:
import ast,sys;d=lambda s:{x.name for x in ast.parse(s).body if isinstance(x,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef,ast.ClassDef))};base='class C:
    def a(self):
        pass
';ours=base+'    def b(self):
        pass
';theirs=base+'    def c(self):
        pass
';res=ours;lost=sorted(((d(ours)|d(theirs))-d(base))-d(res));sys.exit(1 if lost==[] else 0)
